digest.component_or_area: Anthropic provider test doubles and lazy import isolation
propositions: Test monkeypatching anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with a function before pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is imported causes a TypeError in the runtime TypeAlias union evaluation at provider import time, blocking auth validation.
The test double representation is the defect; production validation semantics (fail before client construction/request) are correct and must be exercised by the oracle.

Replacing function-shaped test doubles with class-shaped doubles that preserve the SDK symbol contract and retain existing fail-if-constructed tripwires allows lazy-import to complete and reaches the intended secret-free LLMConfigError.
Three live sibling monkeypatch sites in test_rp04_s4_llm_runtime_heldout.py require the same class-preserving fix to prevent import-order-dependent test failure.
